page.overview:
Who is Bulk Biceps?

Bulk Biceps' human counterpart appears in the My Little Pony Equestria Girls franchise. He is a student at Canterlot High School.

Bulk Biceps briefly appears in the encore short Life is a Runway, smiling awkwardly at Rarity when she passes him by. In Friendship Through the Ages, Bulk Biceps partially appears in the audience during Rainbow Dash's verse.

Bulk Biceps makes a minor background appearance during CHS Rally Song.

Bulk Biceps has a brief non-speaking cameo appearance in All's Fair in Love & Friendship Games where Sweetie Drops defeats him in an arm-wrestling contest during a Friendship Games tryout.
